title: K-2SO
description: As a reprogrammed Imperial Security Droid working for the intelligence arm of the Rebel Alliance, K-2S0 was an effective insertion agent, blending in perfectly with other Imperials. Working with Cassian Andor with a direct nature and wry sense of humor, he helped the rebels infiltrate the Citadel Archive on Scarif and steal the Death Star plans, giving up his life to do so.
